name: Avinas
description: Avinas, which translates to 'Ram', is the Lithuanian cousin of the German Schafkopf. Played primarily in the Jurbarkas region, it is a four-player partnership trick-taking game with a highly idiosyncratic trump hierarchy that includes the Queen of Clubs and the Seven of the trump suit as the two highest cards. It is a game of community, tradition, and numerical precision.

content.text: Avinas, which translates to 'Ram', is the Lithuanian cousin of the German Schafkopf. Played primarily in the Jurbarkas region, it is a four-player partnership trick-taking game with a highly idiosyncratic trump hierarchy that includes the Queen of Clubs and the Seven of the trump suit as the two highest cards. It is a game of community, tradition, and numerical precision.
Rooted in the same 18th-century Central European traditions that produced Schafkopf (Sheepshead) and Sjavs. It was preserved in Lithuanian rural communities, particularly along the Niemen river.
4 players in two fixed partnerships (North-South vs. East-West).
Cards are dealt face down in two rounds of 4. If a 7 is accidentally dealt face up, it determines the trump suit and the declarer.

items.text: Solo Avinas: One player declares a suit and plays alone against the other three. This is usually only played when a player holds an exceptionally strong hand.
